prompt:
You describe a photo or rendering from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What object is shown and from which side.
2. Every visible marking: labels, part numbers, logos, connectors, pin markings.
3. Dimensions or scale, if shown.

Figure type: photo or rendering
Section: 7 PCB Design Guidelines > 7.6 Placement rules for the middle and bottom layers
Caption: Figure 21: Middle and bottom layer placement examples
Text inside the figure (read from this image by a specialised OCR model; use these spellings): U1 | C2 | RIGHT: Power plane on MIDDLE or BOTTOM layer under the sensor | RIGHT: Signal routing on MIDDLE or BOTTOM layer under the sensor
Text that mentions the figure: Power plane or signal routing can be done on the middle and the bottom layer below the sensor. See Figure 21. Note that this bottom placement rule only applies to MEMS accelerometers, gyroscopes, and pressure sensors. The BMI2xy/BMI3xy and BHI3xy share these rules.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Rendering of two PCB layer examples from the middle and bottom layers under a sensor.

Left image:
- Component labels visible: C1, C2, U1.
- Text label: RIGHT: Power plane on MIDDLE or BOTTOM layer under the sensor.
- The image displays a power plane routing pattern on the PCB layer.

Right image:
- Component labels visible: C1, C2, U1.
- Text label: RIGHT: Signal routing on MIDDLE or BOTTOM layer under the sensor.
- The image displays a signal routing pattern on the PCB layer.

No dimensions or scale are shown.
